about_short_description.short_description: Sinbad Tech is a fintech company that provides artificial intelligence and investment management services.

product.name: Sindbad.Tech Trading Bots
product.description: Cloud-based automated trading bots that execute buy and sell orders on stock markets using AI algorithms, operating 24/7 without user intervention.

product.name: Capital Protection Signal
product.description: A predictive analytics service using big data to forecast market trends and protect investment capital by signaling market rises and declines weeks in advance.

product.name: Backtesting Platform
product.description: A system that uses 20 years of historical market data to evaluate the performance and accuracy of trading strategies and algorithms.

product.name: Sindbad.Tech Mobile Application
product.description: Mobile app available on iOS and Android that provides access to trading bots, daily reports, and user interaction with automated trading services.
